change_scope: Post-video observation memory persistence; no model predictive promotion
corrected_causes: Previous consolidated visual learning state was overwritten without immutable revision archive
No SHA-256 predecessor link for every new memory revision
Re-running the same learning state could manufacture redundant revisions
Corruption of an archived prior revision was not checked before advancing the pointer

integration.combined_behavior: checkpoint reuse restores memory; state revisions archived with predecessor digests; neither path grants predictive authority
